newsitem.title: GREECE: POLITICIANS SHOULD BE RESPONSIBLE FOR THEIR ACTIONS-LYMBERIS.
newsitem.headline: POLITICIANS SHOULD BE RESPONSIBLE FOR THEIR ACTIONS-LYMBERIS.

text.p: The former chief of Greece's armed forces admiral Christos Lymberis said on Wednesday that politicians should assume responsibility for their actions but reserved further comments on the Imia crisis until after the elections.

Lymberis who was a member of the socialist party's central committee in the past was fired by socialist Premier Costas Simitis over his handling of the Greek-Turkish crisis in February when the two countries came close to war over the Imia islets.
Simitis has said during the election campaign that his orders to the armed forces to prevent Turkish troops from landing on the islets had not been not executed.

The conservative New Democracy party has been sharply critical of Simitis over his management of the Imia crisis but offered no reaction to Lymberis' statement. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
